newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Anzoil says Vietnam well flows oil.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Anzoil says Vietnam well flows oil.

text.p: Anzoil NL said on Wednesday that its Song Thai Binh BIO-1x well, onshore Hanoi Basin in Vietnam, had flowed oil of an average rate of 164 barrels per day.
The company said the flow was through a 3/4 inch choke with an average well head pressure of 123 pounds per square inch.
The results were obtained during a production test of the 1225 metres to 1237 metres interval.
Anzoil operates the well through its 80 percent owned subsidiary, Anzoil (Asia) Pte Ltd. Frontier Petroleum NL holds the remaining 20 percent of Anzoil(Asia) Pte Ltd.
Anzoil said the Thai Binh BIO-Ix location was some 24 km north-northeast of the Tien Hai gas field and some 16 km north-northeast of its gas find at the Song Tra Ly DI4-Ix well.
Song Thai Binh BIO-Ix is the third in Anzoil's current three well exploratory drilling campaign.
Anzoil announced a gas discovery in its first exploratory well, Song Tra Ly D14-Ix, while the second well, Boo Son K2-lx, was plugged and abandoned after encountering tight gas sands.
By 3.45 p.m. (0545 GMT), Anzoil shares were steady at 15 cents on turnover of 1.5 million shares.
Frontier shares were half a cent higher at 20.5 cents on turnover of 549,474 shares.
